newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. welfare task force to delay report - paper.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. welfare task force to delay report - paper.

text.p: A task force set up by New York State Gov. George Pataki to analyze the impact of the sweeping new federal welfare bill on the state has delayed its report until the end of October, the Albany Times Union said Tuesday.

The group had hoped to complete its work as soon as early October, and the delay, which was due to the complexity of the new federal bill, led budget officials to tell the paper that they do not know whether the budget will be done by December.
Pataki last year had proposed his budget by December, the paper said.
While the state does not have to submit its new welfare plan to Washington until July 1, the earlier the plan is completed, the bigger the windfall for which the state qualifies.
